notes.title: NEW MODE AVAILABLE : ABYSS & TRUE HELL
notes.notes: [p]Recently, we have received feedback that the game is too easy. Even in Hard Mode, many players felt the difficulty was lacking, so we have prepared an even more extreme challenge.[/p][p]This idea started from a player suggestion: removing the jump trajectory display would make the game much harder. We have implemented this as the new Abyss Mode, which can be toggled on or off according to your preference.[/p][p]When combined with Hard Mode, it becomes True Hell Mode. No flashlight, no trajectory display. Can you possibly clear it?[/p][p]We have also fixed various bugs and made minor updates to improve UI and overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]Filling Burrtio Studio[/p]

notes.title: Finally! The first Hard Mode clear is here. Congratulations!
notes.notes:
[p]For nearly two months after launch, no one had reached the end of Hard Mode.
But that silence has finally been broken — the first clear came in after our announcement.[/p][p]A big congratulations.
Whoever you are, you made it to the end first. That's impressive.[/p][p]Others can absolutely do it too.
If you've cleared it, post a screenshot or leave a review — and if you have a speedrun video, even better.
If you haven't cleared it yet, now's the time to jump in.
We're always cheering you on.[/p][p]Filling Burrito Studio[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]image: [url="https://Flaticon.com"]Flaticon.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Hard Mode: 2 Months, 0 Winners
notes.notes: [p]It's been nearly two months since release, and not a single player has cleared Hard Mode.[/p][p]A bit disheartening, honestly.[/p][p]To make things slightly more manageable, we've increased the default light size in Hard Mode with a small balance patch.[/p][p]Just a little more light—maybe enough to make the impossible possible.[/p]

notes.title: Jumfrog Update v.0.6.0
notes.notes:
[b]Dive deeper into the darkness.[/b]

Hello, players!

We are deeply grateful for the overwhelming interest and heartfelt feedback we received during Steam Next Fest. Every wishlist and comment you left has been a huge motivation for us.

With this major update, [b]we've made significant changes to the game's atmosphere and gameplay.[/b] We hope you enjoy an even more thrilling adventure through this new experience.

[h2]🔄 Key Changes[/h2]

[b]1. Introduction of a Limited Visibility System[/b]

[list]
[*]We've added a new mechanism that drastically limits the player's field of view, maximizing tension.
[*]This system adds a strategic element to the existing jump mechanics, providing players with a new challenge.
[*]The uncertainty caused by limited visibility further enhances the horror.
[/list]

[b]2. Massive Atmosphere and Visual Overhaul[/b]

[list]
[*]We've completely redesigned the overall atmosphere and visuals of the game.
[*]The story has also been significantly revised to match the new atmosphere, and details have been added to increase immersion.
[*]The images and descriptions on the Steam store page have also been updated to reflect the new concept.
[/list]

[b]3. Stability and Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]We've fixed major bugs, including the issue where the game didn't correctly recognize resolutions.
[*]Other minor gameplay issues have also been improved to provide a more stable playing environment.
[/list]

[h2]💌 To Our Existing Players[/h2]

For those who have enjoyed the previous demo version, these changes may feel unfamiliar. However, please understand that this decision was made to deliver a more polished game based on your feedback.

We will continue to listen to your opinions and constantly improve to provide the best gaming experience.

[h2]🎯 Future Plans[/h2]

This update is not the end, but the beginning! We promise to continue to incorporate your feedback and make the game even better.

Do you have any bug reports or suggestions for improvement?

📧 Feel free to contact us anytime at [url=https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=mailto%3Acontact%40fillingburritostudio.com]contact@fillingburritostudio.com[/url]!

Thank you.

[b]Filling Burrito Studio[/b]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest: New Gameplay System Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers!

We're excited to announce that Jumfrog will be participating in the [b]Steam Next Fest February 2025[/b]! During this event, you'll have the opportunity to experience our updated demo featuring completely revamped gameplay.

[h3]Major Update Preview 🎮[/h3]

To celebrate Steam Next Fest, we have some exciting news to share. We've been working on a [b]comprehensive system update[/b] that will take the fun to the next level.

Key update features:

[list]
[*][b]New Gameplay System[/b]: Redesigned core mechanics for a more strategic and immersive playing experience
[*][b]Balance Improvements[/b]: Overall system adjustments based on player feedback
[*][b]Graphics Upgrade[/b]: Enhanced visuals and optimized performance
[/list]

This update will bring you a completely fresh gaming experience. Detailed patch notes will be revealed during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], so stay tuned!

We sincerely thank everyone who has shown love and support for Jumfrog. Your valuable feedback has been the driving force behind our journey to create a better game.

Come experience the new Jumfrog at Steam Next Fest!

Thank you,
Filling Burrito Studio
